items.name: theme
items.title: Context.dev theme
items.description: The Context.dev tokens and the Tailwind names that read them. Product screens opt in with the ds-product class.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Questions in medium weight on light rules, with a chevron that turns over when open.

items.name: agent-setup-window
items.title: Agent setup window
items.description: The home page's dark window with the ways to set an agent up (Prompt, MCP, CLI) as tabs that cycle while it is on screen, agent logos that copy the prompt, a copy button, and the prompt revealed word by word.

items.name: alternative-sections
items.title: Alternative page sections
items.description: The sections of an alternatives page. A quick comparison card for the hero's blue frame, why switch (a featured reason card and tagged cards in the soft blue ring), the full comparison and the cost per 1,000 pages as ringed tables with our column tinted, and which one fits with two bullet cards and switch quotes.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: The one-line strip above the site's header, a cool gray band with a hairline under it and the message centered; as a link, hover lays a neutral wash over the band.

items.name: announcement-dot-strip
items.title: Announcement dot strip
items.description: Three rows of faint dots along the announcement strip above the header, with a clear gap around its label; dots brighten briefly at random and under the pointer.

items.name: api-grid-glyph
items.title: API grid glyph
items.description: Every API as a small dot tile in one grid, with a highlight that hops between them and names the one it lands on.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The product shell: canvas, sidebar with its groups and footer, the top bar with the credits menu, and the page's own scroller.

items.name: app-sidebar
items.title: App sidebar
items.description: The product sidebar on the canvas: workspace and search at the top, one centered list of groups, billing cards, Help, Documentation and the account at the foot; a drawer on phones.

items.name: app-top-bar
items.title: App top bar
items.description: Level with the sidebar's workspace row, no title and no fill: the menu button on phones and the credits at the right.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture with white initials on the brand blue as the fallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The product's status label (the word in mono, colored by status) and tag chip, and the site's hairline chip.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A notice across the top of a page, blue for news or soft red for trouble, with actions at the end.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Stacked bars with rounded tops that grow in once, glide between values, a legend that picks series out, and the shared chart tooltip.

items.name: blog-cards
items.title: Blog cards
items.description: Tall post cards, cover on top and date, title and summary below, alternating white and brand blue, a translucent white ring on hover, and the home page's dark Latest updates band that holds them.

items.name: blog-post
items.title: Blog post
items.description: A post in the ruled column. The title with its closing words in blue, a subtitle and the author and dates over a dot field, a header rule, then the article in a reading column with the site's prose (regular headings, muted body at 1.7, blue check bullets, a soft blue quote bar, images and tables as ringed white cards), and related posts as blue cards.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The brand's buttons. The product's controls (black primary, brand blue, outline, outline brand, ghost, on brand; sm 32px and md 40px) and the site's pills.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The product's white card with its hairline in the shadow, and the site's card in a soft blue ring.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16px box, brand blue when checked.

items.name: code-card
items.title: Code card
items.description: The call in mono straight on the card, folded to five lines until expanded, copy in the corner, and a footer with the language chip, the fold and an Open in row.

items.name: code-window
items.title: Code window
items.description: The site's near-black terminal window in the soft blue ring, with window dots, a label chip, actions, a tabbed variant for languages with a fixed scrolling code area, and the install command pill that sits beside it.

items.name: collapse
items.title: Collapse
items.description: Grows to its content's height and back, so what sits below glides rather than jumps.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A search field over grouped destinations with keyboard hints below, in a dialog that opens without animation.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: A table in a white card in the soft blue glass ring, the brand's column tinted blue. `text` for answers in words under h5 heads with captions, `marks` for checks, dashes and short figures under category headings.

items.name: competitor-charts
items.title: Competitor charts
items.description: The benchmark card: mono folder tabs (Success rate, Latency, Cost vs success) over dot-meter charts on the brand's faint rings, the brand in blue and others in gray.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: An icon button that turns into a green check once copied.

items.name: credits-dot-number
items.title: Credits dot number
items.description: A number drawn in the brand dot grid, solid dots on a field of rings that fade toward the edges, morphing on screen into the same number (or a word) in Doto and back.

items.name: credits-menu
items.title: Credits menu
items.description: The top bar's credits: a gem and the credits left, opening the plan, a dot meter, refresh and rate limit, auto top-up and the upgrade and usage actions.

items.name: cta
items.title: Call to action
items.description: The home page's closing call to action (a white card in the soft blue ring with the offer card beside the heading) and the call to action band on the dimmed brand-blue water, with its dashed frame, nodes and its light and glass buttons.

items.name: customer-logo-dots
items.title: Customer logo dots
items.description: A customer's logo redrawn in the brand dot grid over a faint ring backdrop; inside a link, hover or focus melts it into an arrow.

items.name: customer-stories
items.title: Customer stories
items.description: Tall brand-blue story cards in a full-width row that scrolls natively (the next card peeks past the edge), dragged with a mouse or moved a card at a time by the arrows, with one dot per card.

items.name: customer-story-page
items.title: Customer story page
items.description: A customer story's first section, under the header: a back link, the title at section-heading size with its closing words in blue and the date over an optional dot field, a rule, then the story in a 48rem column.

items.name: data-toolbar
items.title: Data toolbar
items.description: The search at the left (a 32px bordered field, or an icon that opens a blue-ringed field) and the filters at the right.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A white panel in a 6px frame, top-aligned at 12vh, rising as it fades in. Focus trap, scroll lock and Escape included.

items.name: docs-link
items.title: Docs link
items.description: A small muted link to the docs with a book and an arrow that nudges on hover.

items.name: dot-engine
items.title: Dot engine
items.description: The dot animation engine the site's stories and the product's glyphs share. Pictures drawn on the brand dot grid that melt, build or sweep from one to the next on a canvas, with a static SVG resting picture.

items.name: dot-glyph
items.title: Dot glyph
items.description: An icon drawn on a small grid of dots, the brand's dot language.

items.name: dot-shader-image
items.title: Dot shader image
items.description: An image redrawn by the brand dot shader, every subject built from hollow and solid circles over a faint ring backdrop, on white, blue or black.

items.name: dot-shader-playground
items.title: Dot shader playground
items.description: The brand page's shader graphics playground. A large preview on white, blue or black, copy SVG and SVG or PNG downloads, samples, and upload by click, drop or paste.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Row menus with labels, separators, checks and hold-to-confirm destructive rows.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A glyph tile, an h4 title, one balanced line of muted text and the next actions; a one-line row for an empty table.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ section
items.description: Heading on the left; category pills and ringed question cards on the right, ending with an Ask anything card. The list holds room for its tallest answer, or scrolls inside its closed height.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label above a control, help or an error below.

items.name: footer-watermark
items.title: Footer watermark
items.description: The wordmark across the footer's foot, rebuilt from the brand's circles ("context." in rings, "dev" in solid dots); a soft patch follows the pointer and swaps the two. A dotted cursor can click a button beside it and glide onto the letters.

items.name: glide-tabs
items.title: Glide tabs
items.description: A row of options with one pill springing to the picked one, as a soft gray wash or a white pill on a gray track.

items.name: glyph-card
items.title: Glyph card
items.description: The redesign's cards: a glyph-tile header with a title and an aside, a centered big-number card with a corner pill, the arrow link out and status pills.

items.name: glyph-engine
items.title: Glyph engine
items.description: The product's glyph art and players, built on the dot engine. Glyph art, the looping story and melt players, and the pages cover's scene and shader; the dot field, the melt, the story and morph players and the hover morph come from dot-engine and use-hover-dot-morph.

items.name: glyph-loop
items.title: Glyph loop
items.description: A page glyph whose subject sweeps into what it gives you and back, on a loop while on screen.

items.name: glyph-melt
items.title: Glyph melt
items.description: A page glyph that melts into what it gives you while its card is in view, hovered or focused, and eases back when let go.

items.name: glyph-story
items.title: Glyph story
items.description: A glyph pair in the fine dot pattern of the blog covers, the subject melting into what it gives you on a loop. DotStory, the player under it, is in the glyph engine.

items.name: glyph-tile
items.title: Glyph tile
items.description: A page's dot glyph in a small bordered tile that loops between its subject and what it gives you, or held still; StillGlyph is the plain SVG.

items.name: hero-circle-pattern
items.title: Hero circle pattern
items.description: The brand's ring pattern as a surface that clears itself around its marked content, with optional solid diamond clusters, and StoryStage, the faint ring stage a card's dot story plays on.

items.name: hero-data-flow
items.title: Hero data flow
items.description: Dotted strands flowing into the hero's demo from the left and out to the right. `scrape` braids strands with flickering binary; `answers` reads labeled sources one at a time, types the question, and sends the answer out with citation tags.

items.name: hero-dot-field
items.title: Hero dot field
items.description: The hero's dot backdrop. Winding bands of faint dots, rings and a few lit dots, or with `streams`, curved streams of dots running in from the edges toward the content with light pulsing along them; the pointer leaves a trail. Optional words in its gaps and the logo mark in dots in the corner.

items.name: hero-globe
items.title: Hero globe
items.description: A hairline wireframe globe rising from the hero's foot, cut to a dome, with comets running node to node along its grid; HeroGlobeStats sets four stat windows beside its crown, each wired to a node by an elbowed hairline.

items.name: hero-monitor
items.title: Hero monitor
items.description: An old terminal drawn in the brand dot grid, with a 58 by 38 dot story set on its screen. Its silhouette is painted in the surface color, so a dot field or data flow behind it stays hidden.

items.name: hero-pattern-hole
items.title: Hero pattern hole
items.description: The attribute that marks content for the dot patterns to clear around, and the kinds of hole (text, box, snug-box, tight-box, cover, oval).

items.name: hero-stat-morphs
items.title: Hero stat morphs
items.description: Four figures drawn in the brand dot grid in the hero's open corners, each holding, then melting through a run of dot shapes (a monitor, an envelope, a document, a logo) and back on its own clock.

items.name: hero-water
items.title: Hero water
items.description: A WebGL water surface under a white to blue sky that ripples on its own and in the pointer's wake, or printed as a halftone dot screen. A still picture of the water shows where WebGL is missing, on small or touch screens, and under reduced motion.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The site's centered hero on white (the home page, key phrase in blue) or brand blue (inner pages), with an eyebrow line, a pill, the title, one muted line, the actions with their caption, and a ringed blue visual panel with an optional glass tab. It can fill the first screen, stagger in on load and carries data-ds-dots for the dot streams.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold button
items.description: Hold to confirm a destructive action.

items.name: image-dot-shader
items.title: Image dot shader
items.description: The brand kit's dot shader as plain functions. An image in, one dot state per cell of the 80 by 60 grid out (solid, hollow or none), and the picture as an SVG string.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A 40px text field; its border darkens on hover and turns brand blue on focus.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JSON viewer
items.description: A response as numbered, wrapped, foldable lines with search, copy and download.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The label for a form control.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One smooth line over a soft fill, the last stretch dotted while it fills, with a hover marker and the shared chart tooltip.

items.name: logo-dot-sampling
items.title: Logo dot sampling
items.description: Samples a logo image onto a square grid of cells, solid dots for its lighter parts and rings for its darker parts (or its tile).

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: The boxed logo strip under the hero, with a label cell at the left and gray logos in ruled cells looping sideways; the loop coasts to a stop under the pointer and a quote card glides from logo to logo.

items.name: overview-page
items.title: Overview page
items.description: The redesigned overview: the try box, the usage card over four credit and plan cards, the quickstart beside them, and the usage summary dialog.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: The product page column (880px, balanced between the sidebar and the support button) with its centered header, sections and the cards' rise.

items.name: pages-cover
items.title: Pages cover
items.description: The pages blog cover in brand blue, where three pages gather and bind into one, with what goes in and what comes out labeled either side.

items.name: persona-glyph
items.title: Persona glyph
items.description: A small picture in white dots on brand blue that melts between two glyphs (what a team builds, then what the API gives it). `MenuGlyph` is the 36px tile the header menus use as icons, held still.

items.name: playground-parameters
items.title: Playground parameters
items.description: The playground's parameters panel, with groups of rows in soft gray boxes, filled gray fields, a changed count, Reset, scroll fades and a fetching lock.

items.name: playground-result-card
items.title: Playground result card
items.description: The result of a call, with Preview, JSON and History tabs above the card, the status, a stats strip and the response in an inset panel; plus the ready and running states.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel that grows from its trigger.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plan cards in one ringed frame split by hairlines, parts aligned across the row, a glide toggle for monthly or yearly, the two-row shelves with the plan-fit panel, a discount banner, and the credit costs table.

items.name: product-grid
items.title: Product grid
items.description: The home page's product cards in two columns, each with an h3 name, an outline Explore pill, a description, chips and a demo window.

items.name: product-hero
items.title: Product hero (water)
items.description: The blue water product pages. A full-bleed blue hero whose water fades up to white behind a centered two-line title and keyed pills, a centered row of gray customer logos, numbered steps and a compact hairline FAQ in a narrow column, and a blue closing band.

items.name: product-landing
items.title: Product landing sections
items.description: A product page on the home page's design, in the ruled column. Story card sections (three capabilities, two workflows), each a white card in the soft blue ring with a demo window, a code section with an install pill and a docs pill, and an FAQ in one ringed card.

items.name: product-page
items.title: Product page (stage)
items.description: The stage design for a product page. A wide column with two-line headings (black, then blue), the product on a blue stage under the hero, a customer row, figures on a gray panel, capabilities under blue-led hairlines, a tabbed code explorer, a steps timeline, a comparison table, a hairline FAQ, related cards and a blue closing panel.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A thin pill track with a brand-blue fill.

items.name: quickstart-card
items.title: Quickstart card
items.description: Numbered onboarding steps in a glyph card that scroll inside it, with a masked key field, tabbed setup snippets and copy pills.

items.name: ring-backdrop
items.title: Ring backdrop
items.description: A faint grid of rings behind a panel or card, keeping only whole rings: none is sliced by a rounded corner or by content marked `data-ring-clear` on top of it.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A scroller with no scrollbar that fades at whichever edge has more, with a chevron that scrolls the rest into view.

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret field
items.description: A masked API key with show and copy.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A full-bleed site band with its content in the ruled column, the column's edge lines and header rule with their nodes, and the left aligned section heading with its closing words in blue.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: The dashboard's tabs as a value picker, with radio semantics and the gliding pill.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-choice dropdown: a toolbar button, a form field, or a small chip.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups of content.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings as centered tabs (personal, organization, billing, referrals) over cards of fields, switch rows, the billing summary and danger zones.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings section
items.description: A quiet title over a card of rows (title, muted text, control at the right), stacked fields, a notice and the danger button.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel floating over the page's edge in the dialog's frame, with no scrim.

items.name: sidebar-alert-card
items.title: Sidebar alert card
items.description: A billing problem at the foot of the sidebar (a failed payment, a plan ending), the whole card the fix, with a pulsing dot.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The site's near-black footer. The brand block (logo, two-line description, socials and a "Backed by" line) and the compliance badges over a row of inline links sit over a white rule; the link groups run in four columns; the copyright row sits between two rules with nodes on the crossings; and a watermark band with its button closes it.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: The site's header. Edge to edge with no fill at the top of the page, it gathers into a floating white pill in a translucent ring once the page scrolls; menus open as one ringed panel whose menus slide side by side, and below 880px the links move into a full-screen menu under the bar.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pale block with a slow sheen while content loads.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.description: White toasts with a light border, a soft shadow and a close button, at the bottom center.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small loading indicator.

items.name: stat-block
items.title: Stat block
items.description: A big brand-blue figure with a plain caption under it, in a white card inside the soft blue ring.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: A caption title, a 22px tabular figure and a quiet footer; the whole card can be the button or the link, with a dot meter for what's left.

items.name: story-actions
items.title: Actions story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A pointer clicks, an hourglass waits and a mouse scrolls, then the page they leave behind renders.

items.name: story-answer
items.title: Answer story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A question is asked, its sources are read, and the answer is written between braces in the shape that was asked for.

items.name: story-assets
items.title: Assets story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A brand's logo becomes its colors, then a company profile wearing both.

items.name: story-autofill
items.title: Autofill story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A domain is typed, a pointer clicks Auto-fill, and a signup form fills itself field by field.

items.name: story-batch
items.title: Batch story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A job counts up to 25,000 URLs, becomes a page of results, and the page is packed into a box as one dataset.

items.name: story-batches
items.title: Batches story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A batch reads its sources, then counts through its URLs as its progress fills dot by dot.

items.name: story-blog-hero
items.title: Blog hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. A post writes itself line by line, then becomes a megaphone calling out the news.

items.name: story-brand-kit
items.title: Brand kit story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A typed domain becomes a kit box, then the logo, colors, typeface and company details unpacked from it.

items.name: story-collect
items.title: Collect story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A ring fills as the job runs, becomes the results a page at a time, then the paper plane of the completion webhook.

items.name: story-compare-hero
items.title: Compare hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. Two tools checked feature by feature, then their bars rising side by side.

items.name: story-components
items.title: Components story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A button rounds to the site's radius and becomes a card, then the sun and moon of its light and dark themes.

items.name: story-context
items.title: Context story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A company's building becomes its social links, then a profile card whose fields fill in.

items.name: story-crawl
items.title: Crawl story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A sitemap becomes a web, spun outwards a ring of links at a time to the scope that was set.

items.name: story-datasets-hero
items.title: Datasets hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. Source documents collected one by one, then the table they are delivered as filling row by row.

items.name: story-design-system
items.title: Design system story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A live website is scanned and becomes its design system, a board of its type, colors, buttons and spacing.

items.name: story-discover
items.title: Discover story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A radar sweeps a domain and finds its pages, then becomes the list of their URLs.

items.name: story-enrich
items.title: Enrich story
items.description: A looping dot picture. An agent's eye reads an identifier and melts into the company and the person behind it, each with its profile.

items.name: story-extract
items.title: Extract story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A scan reads a published page, which becomes a window with the page's Markdown typed into it.

items.name: story-free-tools-hero
items.title: Free tools hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. A shelf of tools lighting up one by one, then one of them run on a URL.

items.name: story-freshness
items.title: Freshness story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A dial sets how old a copy may be, and becomes the cache or the live web the page then comes from.

items.name: story-generate
items.title: Generate story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A prompt naming a company becomes the spark of the model at work, then the email, social post and landing page it makes in that company's brand.

items.name: story-glossary-hero
items.title: Glossary hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. An open book read line by line, then one entry looked up term after term.

items.name: story-grants-hero
items.title: Grants hero story
items.description: A looping dot picture with a caption column. A reward curve climbing as an experiment runs, then the grant's usage credits awarded a tranche at a time.

items.name: story-identity
items.title: Identity story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A domain, an email, a name and a ticker melt into one another, then into the seal of the brand they resolve to.

items.name: story-metadata
items.title: Metadata story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A tag becomes three mapped URLs, two of which gain their title and description while the third waits.

items.name: story-monitor-ways
items.title: Monitor ways stories
items.description: Three looping dot pictures, one per way to monitor: a page re-scraped until a line changes and its diff, a sitemap that loses one URL and gains one, and an extract instruction read into a scored record.

items.name: story-output
items.title: Output story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A switch is thrown for each format under a live page, which becomes the three files the request returns.

items.name: story-parse
items.title: Parse story
items.description: A looping dot picture. An uploaded PDF is read by OCR and becomes a Markdown document.

items.name: story-parts
items.title: Story parts
items.description: Pieces more than one dot story draws with. The page heroes' shared grid and caption kit, the style guide's letters and swatches, and the prompt field the generate stories type into.

items.name: story-persona
items.title: Persona story
items.description: A looping dot picture for a kind of team: what it builds crumbles under its challenge, a request is answered, and it has what the API gives it, with a three-line caption for each part.

items.name: story-question
items.title: Question story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A pile of pages becomes the question asked instead, then the magnifier that reads for you.

items.name: story-rag
items.title: RAG story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A question is typed into a search field, the field becomes a brain, and the brain hands out the pages that answer it.

items.name: story-research
items.title: Research story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A magnifying glass reads across a company's page, then the page becomes its brand profile: typeface, colors, logo and facts.

items.name: story-scope
items.title: Scope story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A domain takes in its subdomains, then becomes a meter that fills with links and stops at the limit.

items.name: story-scrape
items.title: Scrape story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A URL is typed, its Markdown streams out, and the page is captured as a screenshot with its images lifted out.

items.name: story-search
items.title: Search story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A question is typed at an old terminal, which becomes three ranked results with their pages read.

items.name: story-setup
items.title: Setup story
items.description: A looping dot picture. An envelope opens, becomes a terminal that types an API key, then a package that is unpacked.

items.name: story-site-map
items.title: Site map story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A domain typed under a paper map becomes the site as a tree of its pages, and the pages to scrape are picked.

items.name: story-sources
items.title: Sources story
items.description: A looping dot picture. An answer becomes the link its claims keep, then the answer again with each claim tied to its numbered URL.

items.name: story-spacing
items.title: Spacing story
items.description: A looping dot picture. Two blocks open to each step of the spacing scale, then a card is lifted by each of the shadows.

items.name: story-structure
items.title: Structure story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A paragraph of prose becomes a tree of named fields, which fill with the answer's values.

items.name: story-tenant-theme
items.title: Tenant theme story
items.description: A looping dot picture. One dashboard re-themed for three tenants in turn, each brand spreading across it from the mark in its sidebar.

items.name: story-type
items.title: Type story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A type specimen set from light to bold, then a site's colors read one chip at a time.

items.name: story-url-list
items.title: URL list story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A list of URLs runs up to the batch limit, then one of them is shown with the identifier and metadata it carries.

items.name: story-watch
items.title: Watch story
items.description: A looping dot picture. A clock checks a page on its schedule until a check finds a change, then becomes a bell beside the notice of what changed.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Marks an area as product or site, so its components and their overlays use that scale.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle; brand blue when on.

items.name: table-page
items.title: Table page
items.description: The API keys page; a centered header, the plan's key allowance, search and status filter, the keys table with hold-to-confirm row menus, and the empty page.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A table on a card: a faint header band, rows on light lines, tabular numbers.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between views. The product's plain labels with a soft gray pill gliding to the selected one (or `segmented`, a white pill on a gray track), or the site's pills with a blue-outlined pill gliding between them.

items.name: tag-filter
items.title: Tag filter
items.description: The picked tags as clearable blue chips, then a Tags button that opens a searchable, checkable list.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags input
items.description: A field that turns typed or pasted values into small blue chips, red when invalid.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Quote cards on a hairline, all the same anatomy; the active card's highlighted phrases turn brand blue.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text entry with the input's border and states.

items.name: theme-store
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: Light, dark or system for the product, kept across visits and applied before first paint.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on hover or focus; waits a beat, then appears at once for neighbors.

items.name: trust-strip
items.title: Trust strip
items.description: Three security cards in the soft blue ring, each with a blue dot mark (`TrustMark`: compliance, policies, controls), a title, a sentence and an outline pill; the whole card is the link.

items.name: try-api
items.title: Try API box
items.description: The overview's lead: API tabs on a gray track with a gliding white pill, an input that types its examples, and a square blue run button.

items.name: upgrade-glyph
items.title: Upgrade glyph
items.description: The upgrade card's picture, a gift that melts into a rocket and back, in the fine dot pattern.

items.name: usage-card
items.title: Usage card
items.description: The overview's usage chart: the breakdown menu as its title, the range on a gliding pill, stacked bars and a legend that picks series out per breakdown.

items.name: usage-summary
items.title: Usage summary
items.description: The usage page at a glance in a dialog: credits remaining over a long dot meter, today's and this month's use, and a ranked bar list.

items.name: use-case-features
items.title: Use case features
items.description: The use case pages' feature cards in the soft blue ring (a marker, a title that can link, tags, a code chip and a dot story in a demo window), the closing note card, the comparison table with Context.dev's column on a faint blue wash, and the before and after panels.

items.name: use-case-how-it-works
items.title: Use case how it works
items.description: The numbered steps in a ring card with the install command for the picked language, the docs pill and a note, beside a tabbed code window in every SDK language; or a card per step with its own code.

items.name: use-case-personas
items.title: Use case personas
items.description: Who a use case is for, a ring card per persona two across, with its glyph or icon tile, its role, and the challenge, solution and impact (impact in blue), or a dot story with the part it is playing written beneath.

items.name: use-case-proof
items.title: Use case proof
items.description: The use case pages' proof blocks in the soft blue ring: customers as outlined chips, a large quote card beside a stack of brand-blue metrics, example cards with an arrow link to the customer, and story cards with their headline number.

items.name: use-cases
items.title: Use cases
items.description: A tabbed explorer in the soft blue ring, the use cases listed on the left with a pale brand-tint card gliding to the picked one, the code for each in a code window; it steps through them every six seconds while on screen, with a countdown donut.

items.name: use-hold
items.title: useHold
items.description: Fires an action only after the pointer or key is held for a set time.

items.name: use-hover-dot-morph
items.title: Hover dot morph
items.description: Plays a dot morph on a canvas while its card is hovered or focused, and lets it settle back home after. The card is the nearest link or button, or the nearest element marked `data-hover-morph` when it is neither.

items.name: use-tab-glide
items.title: useTabGlide
items.description: Glides one pill to the selected tab on a spring, starting from wherever it is mid-glide.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: The account at the foot of the sidebar, opening upward with who you are, link groups, the theme switch and Log out.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: Merges class names, aware of the brand's scales (text-body-sm, rounded-card, shadow-floating).

items.name: workflow-grid
items.title: Workflow grid
items.description: Cards in the soft blue ring, three across on wide screens, each with an h4 title, a short description and a picture panel of fixed shape.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace switcher
items.description: The workspace at the top of the sidebar, listing the default and the other workspaces with plan tags, make-default and settings.
